verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-definable rules engine in Mollie for configuring event-triggered actions. Webhooks, including next-gen event-type subscriptions, only deliver event notifications to the developer's own endpoint, so any resulting action must be built by the user, which makes them a developer building block. The other automatic behaviors are fixed, narrow features rather than user-defined rules: application fees moved on payment success, Magento auto-capture when an order is marked shipped, and interval-based subscriptions, which are a recurring schedule rather than an event trigger.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
